requirements.question: What is changing in Earth orbit: which launches, releases, reentries, catalog changes and (once the lane is live) non-routine manoeuvres, by whom?
Which watched objects' published orbits changed by more than their own element sets usually move (at least 0.25 m/s in geostationary orbit, 0.05 m/s elsewhere) in the past 30 days?
requirements.note: Live from orbit-2.4 (14 Nov 2026): Space-Track element sets for a private watch list; in the feed as kind maneuver. See method.md.

requirements.question: Which orbital launches has GCAT recorded in the last 7 days, from which sites, with which payloads and owner states?
What is the change's dominant term (in-track, cross-track, eccentricity), size in m/s, change in semi-major axis and inclination, and, in geostationary orbit, longitude and drift before and after?
Does the watched satellite have a TLE tracking gap >=48 hours that degrades maneuver detection confidence?
requirements.note: Live from orbit-2.4: a change measured across a gap of 48 hours or more is labelled with the gap.

requirements.question: Which launches are scheduled in the next 14 days, from which pads, by which providers, to which orbits?
requirements.note: Answered by Launch from orbit-2.32 (25 Nov 2026, ideas#69; Launch's LA-PIR-3, items launch:upcoming:*). Orbit no longer reads Launch Library 2 or puts items under this requirement; kept so that older orbit:upcoming items still resolve.

requirements.question: Which objects has GCAT newly cataloged from launches more than 30 days old (releases from a host, breakups, late identifications), and which objects changed owner or owner state?
Which objects has GCAT dated as reentered in the last 7 days, by type and owner state?
Which objects has GCAT marked as exploded or collided (status E or C) in the last 30 days, with the date, owner state and parent?
